name: Controller Battery Bar
description: Game controller battery as a ring in the bar: it empties as the battery drains, keeps the percentage inside and changes colour (green above 30%, amber down to 10%, red below), with a popout showing each controller's name, state, energy, draw and MAC address. It lives only in the panel, so it is visible while playing and reads at a glance: a more graphical, colour-coded alternative to the generic battery indicator the system shows.
